Running low on fresh water should never
hold a ship up. Malik, our own water barge,
brings clean drinking water out to vessels at
Khorfakkan and Fujairah. Because we own
and run the barge ourselves, we set the
Drinking water delivered by our own
Crew changes and small deliveries are often
planned around tight windows. As your
agent, we arrange crew boats at Khorfakkan
and Fujairah to move people, stores and
light cargo between shore and ship, and we
keep you updated until the job is done.
Crew transfers between shore and ship
Delivery of ship stores and spare parts
A port call has many moving parts. We act as
your agent on the UAE east coast, so
owners, operators and masters deal with
one team that coordinates the call, handles
Port call coordination with the port and
Send us your vessel name and location
